story.text: 노을이 지는 골목을 벌써 세 바퀴째 돌고 있었다. 규현이 휴대폰 지도를 이리저리 돌려 보며 미간을 살짝 좁혔다.
story.reading: no-eul-i ji-neun gol-mok-eul beol-sseo se ba-kwi-jjae dol-go iss-eot-da. gyu-hyeon-i hyu-dae-pon ji-do-reul i-ri-jeo-ri dol-lyeo bo-myeo mi-gan-eul sal-jjak jop-hyeot-da.
story.en: We'd already circled the same alley three times as the sunset deepened. Kyuhyun turned his phone map this way and that, brow furrowing slightly.

story.text: "우리 지금 길 잃은 거 맞죠?" 내가 묻자, 그는 헛기침을 하며 딴청을 부렸다. "아니, 뭐, 살짝 헤매는 중이라고 해두죠."
story.reading: "u-ri ji-geum gil il-eun geo mat-jyo?" nae-ga mut-ja, geu-neun heot-gi-chim-eul ha-myeo ttan-cheong-eul bu-ryeot-da. "a-ni, mwo, sal-jjak he-mae-neun jung-i-ra-go hae-du-jyo."
story.en: "We're lost right now, aren't we?" I asked, and he cleared his throat and played it off. "No, well, let's just say we're 'slightly wandering.'"

story.text: 결국 그가 손을 들어 도로 쪽으로 흔들었다. "됐어요, 자존심보다 택시가 낫죠." 마침 빈 택시 한 대가 스르륵 다가와 멈춰 섰다.
story.reading: gyeol-guk geu-ga son-eul deul-eo do-ro jjok-eu-ro heun-deul-eot-da. "dwaess-eo-yo, ja-jon-sim-bo-da taek-si-ga nat-jyo." ma-chim bin taek-si han dae-ga seu-reu-reuk da-ga-wa meom-chwo seot-da.
story.en: In the end, he raised his hand and waved it toward the road. "That's it, a taxi beats my pride." Just then, an empty taxi glided up and stopped.

story.text: 차에 올라타자 규현이 밝게 인사했다. "기사님, 안녕하세요." 백미러 너머로 기사님이 웃으며 고개를 끄덕였다.
story.reading: cha-e ol-la-ta-ja gyu-hyeon-i balk-ge in-sa-haet-da. "gi-sa-nim, an-nyeong-ha-se-yo." baeng-mi-reo neo-meo-ro gi-sa-nim-i us-eu-myeo go-gae-reul kkeu-deok-yeot-da.
story.en: As we climbed into the car, Kyuhyun greeted the driver cheerfully. "Hello, driver." Through the rearview mirror, the driver smiled and nodded.

story.text: "이 주소로 가주세요." 규현이 휴대폰 화면을 내밀며 말했다. 기사님이 화면을 흘긋 보고는 능숙하게 핸들을 꺾었다.
story.reading: "i ju-so-ro ga-ju-se-yo." gyu-hyeon-i hyu-dae-pon hwa-myeon-eul nae-mil-myeo mal-haet-da. gi-sa-nim-i hwa-myeon-eul heul-geut bo-go-neun neung-suk-ha-ge haen-deul-eul kkeok-eot-da.
story.en: "Please take us to this address." Kyuhyun said, holding out his phone screen. The driver glanced at it and skillfully turned the wheel.

story.text: "그러게, 걸어서 찾을 수 있다고 큰소리치더니." 내가 슬쩍 놀리자, 그는 창밖을 보는 척하며 대답을 피했다. "…그건 그때고, 이건 이거고요."
story.reading: "geu-reo-ge, geol-eo-seo chaj-eul su it-da-go keun-so-ri-chi-deo-ni." nae-ga seul-jjeok nol-li-ja, geu-neun chang-bakk-eul bo-neun cheok-ha-myeo dae-dab-eul pi-haet-da. "…geu-geon geu-ttae-go, i-geon i-geo-go-yo."
story.en: "Uh-huh, and here I thought someone was so sure we could just walk there." I teased him a little, and he looked out the window, avoiding an answer. "...That was then, this is now."

story.text: 목적지 앞에 다다르자 규현이 몸을 앞으로 기울이며 말했다. "기사님, 여기서 세워주세요." 차가 멈추고, 우리는 웃음을 참으며 내렸다.
story.reading: mok-jeok-ji ap-e da-da-reu-ja gyu-hyeon-i mom-eul ap-eu-ro gi-ul-i-myeo mal-haet-da. "gi-sa-nim, yeo-gi-seo se-wo-ju-se-yo." cha-ga meom-chu-go, u-ri-neun us-eum-eul cham-eu-myeo nae-ryeot-da.
story.en: As we neared our destination, Kyuhyun leaned forward and said, "Driver, please stop here." The car pulled over, and we got out, trying hard not to laugh.

words.example_en: Please hail a taxi for me.
Please take me to this address.
